title: hack
description: Create stacked branch + worktree + tmux session

title: unhack
description: Tear down worktree + session for a merged branch

title: swap
description: Move a worktree branch into the main directory

title: unswap
description: Restore main branch and reattach the worktree

title: review HEAD
description: Open the next-up PR awaiting your review

title: review
description: Review a branch, PR number, PR URL, or Linear ticket

title: review log
description: PRs awaiting your review, with 24h business-day SLA

title: review snooze
description: Drop a PR to the bottom of the stack until end of day

action.tmux: display-popup -w 60% -h 5 -E 'zsh -lc "read \"r?ref to snooze: \" && [ -n \"$r\" ] && palette-action review snooze \"$r\""'

title: review unsnooze
description: Put a snoozed PR back in the review rotation

action.tmux: display-popup -w 60% -h 5 -E 'zsh -lc "read \"r?ref to unsnooze (blank for all): \" && if [ -n \"$r\" ]; then palette-action review unsnooze \"$r\"; else palette-action review unsnooze --all; fi"'
